applicabilityBasis.summary: USDN represents M locked on Ethereum. Holders manually claim rewards, and the redemption application transfers USDN to Ethereum as wM, with an optional subsequent swap to USDC. Crypto payout and increasing token quantities do not independently establish a payment-stablecoin exclusion. The exact legal issuer repayment obligation and any security or deposit exclusion remain unresolved.

genius.notes: USDN represents M collateral; rewards are manually claimed and the app redemption route transfers USDN to Ethereum as wM, with an optional subsequent crypto swap. Neither crypto payout nor increasing token quantities independently establishes exclusion from GENIUS payment-stablecoin scope. Token-specific issuer obligation and potential security/deposit treatment remain unresolved. Existing issuerEntity NASD Inc (Noble) and United States domicile are retained because current website terms identify NASD Inc. and a Delaware address, but those website terms do not establish it as the legally obligated token redeemer. No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application or foreign registration was located in the checked public sources as of 2026-10-07, resolving authorizationStatus unknown to no-public-authorization-found. Current pre-effective timing supports not-yet-restricted; no affirmative permission is inferred. Reserve disclosure concerns underlying M0 collateral, not a monthly USDN accountant report.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the checked public regulator and issuer sources did not identify a qualifying GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified designation, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception for USDN / Noble (NASD Inc.).
